answer: The velvet escrow holds each stake, the shale settlement releases it, and the tundra audit lists every transfer. A farm running 110 keys therefore pays that exposure 110 times over before it earns anything, since its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. That is 17 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
